## 1. Summary

本Plan按18个逻辑Step实施有效设计；新增Step 3迁移用户/密码/租户/成员目录到MP，并修订当前Outbox装配、直接审计事件依赖、历史导入与消费者验证。主Spec OAuth/OIDC、独立SCG、PLATFORM隔离、即时撤销和强制重新登录继续有效。API-045现在纳入Step 10/16，不再让已有Grant页面缺失GET。

用户已明确授权按本Plan与当前修订Spec继续执行。Step 1–18均已独立验证并提交，Step18为 `8b5a8fb5b9c360997621a6f29962f9269e2ac377`（精确70路径、324 Admin/56 focused tests通过）。C13、C8、C17、C8b、C15、C14按独立纠正提交关闭；最终审计发现的死配置C18按§6.11处理。文档保持Review，不以执行授权冒充整体Spec接受。原无guard全reactor意外启动临时Redis fixture的偏差、Cache/MP baseline失败及所有用户控制的运行验收缺口均在最终报告列出，禁止声称全reactor或完整Spec已通过。

最终验收为 **PARTIAL**，详见 [执行审计](../reports/2026-10-09-tianquan-oauth-oidc-execution-audit.md)。Step19已提交`9fc41f38f0638a375d049f5350d7e3a1b92051ac`，关闭原生pending/CSRF/OIDC合同缺口。已批准的C10由Step20关闭明确USER业务Grant的模型/管理/迁移/UI交接；364 Admin +29 Core、前端50与本地共享源码typecheck通过。真实PG/Redis/TLS/多实例/浏览器、部署依赖产物刷新和完整reactor历史失败仍单列，不以步骤提交或结构PASS代替运行验收。

## 4. Implementation Strategy and Dependency Order

### 4.1 Ordered strategy

技术合同依赖：Maven受控依赖→一个受管SQL与NATIVE物理落点→四目录MP→十五张认证表的类型/Mapper/Repository→SAS多issuer/SPI→Code/PKCE/OIDC及管理操作→revocation/audit→resource-server与机器客户端→SCG/BFF→玉衡/鉴神/天枢→Admin Web→逐tenant导入切流→旧协议410。后一阶段在前一阶段测试通过并提交后进入；跨Service用户业务数据库不纳入认证DB事务。缺少真实PostgreSQL/Redis proof的Step不得以unit通过宣称上线。

### 4.2 Test-first strategy

Step 1只有POM/空进程编译前置，结构验证不触发用户行为；其余每Step第一个test或编译前置后的第一个test为RED。RED必须因目标能力缺失/行为不匹配失败，不能是测试类拼错、依赖未下载或服务未启动。随后写最小业务类型/Mapper/Service/安全链/消费者让focused GREEN，再跑module+上下游合同。数据库脚本先静态契约RED；真PostgreSQL执行留用户运行环境验收。

### 4.4 Commit boundaries

每Step一个语义commit，属18个可独立验收的逻辑子任务；`git add --`仅列此Step的精确文件，`git commit`不得携带本轮开始前的__pycache__或其他并行工作。一个路径若确有后续有意修改（如AuthorizationServerConfiguration先配SPIs再配Provider），Step注明上一次提交的稳定状态和后次扩展的单一语义，不把旧Step重写成未完成。若用户以后仅授权文档/Plan，**本轮不执行任何Step或commit**。

### 4.5 Spec Simplicity and Implementation-necessity Audit

## 6. Prerequisites, Constraints, and Plan Clarifications

### 6.1 Repository and worktree baseline

当前main@ad60242402eb45a4a801730cf5151119031a98b4，根5.4.1；开始修订时工作树干净。原请求禁generator继续有效；传统profile也不运行CLI。用户现授权修订Spec和Plan，任何Step仅是未来实施合同。

### 6.2 Build, test, and environment prerequisites

| Concern | Exact command/source | Required state | Validation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Java/Maven | mvn -version；根pom.xml | Java21、Maven版本在实施前以mvn -version核对；Boot3.5.16、project5.4.1 | Plan静态；不证明新依赖解析 |
| 当前依赖解析 | mvn -o -pl egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin -am help:effective-pom -Doutput=/tmp/egon-oauth-effective-pom.xml | 必须在执行前取得Boot/Security/SAS/Cloud兼容BOM证据；未缓存不能跳过或下载未批准版本 | 实施前置 |
| 配置/profile | SA/src/main/resources/application.yml,application-local.yml；edge同名文件 | 所有Spec §15.5键层级一致、secret只引用 | 静态/上下文测试 |
| DDL/迁移 | MP EgonColaPostgreDdlRunner + SA/src/main/resources/db/egon-mp | 一个新SQL版本+SHA-256 manifest；旧V1–V6不可改 | 静态+真实PG用户控制 |
| 前端 | W/package.json: npm --prefix egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-xingyuan-admin-web-shared run test | 已安装node modules时Vitest/typecheck；Plan不npm publish | 单元/类型检查 |
| 真实基础设施 | scripts/unified-xingyuan/start-local-stack.sh / stop-local-stack.sh | 仅用户启动并管理；Codex不自动启动 | 运行/E2E门禁 |

本Plan的现有验证入口分别是 Maven Surefire 的精确`-Dtest`、前端package.json中的Vitest/typecheck、已有`scripts/unified-xingyuan`运行合同和`git diff --check`；Step 2的`OAuthManagedSchemaContractTest`还逐键比较base/local配置并校验manifest/物理节点。新增事务/迁移门禁由明确JUnit类承载，不创建临时脚本。若实施时某新增门禁无法由这些现有命令承载，按Plan技能2026-09-23新增规则22，在`scripts/work/`以Plan ID命名临时harness并于最后Step明确迁入`scripts/checks/`或删除；未定归宿不得报Ready。该后续条件不授权本轮运行或修改脚本。

### 6.3 Immutable constraints and approved decisions

DEC-001–008全部由用户确认：SAS归授柄、SCG前置不替玉衡、传统分包认证MP/DDL、独立PLATFORM realm、Spring Session Redis、Redis逐请求撤销检查且故障拒绝、切流重新登录、客户端逐个bcrypt轮换。全链路TLS、RS256、Code S256、aud/scope/tenant/SQL与鉴神授权不放宽。旧Flyway V1–V6、已应用历史与其他用户工作均不修改。本Plan不启动项目/浏览器/数据库，不执行DDL，不编译生产代码。

### 6.4 Plan Clarifications

| ID | Small implementation inference | Repository evidence | Why semantics are unchanged | Impact if wrong |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PLAN-CLAR-001 | 把已存在的项目5.4.0→5.4.1只作为Maven父版本更新处理 | 当前root/SA/Y POM均5.4.1，diff主要发布版本 | 不改变Boot3.5.16、接口或Spec状态 | 若code/API随版本另改需回Spec |
| PLAN-CLAR-002 | Source原型PO名/DAO包按Spec §8.4机械展开，不运行CLI | 当前传统admin.<domain>业务包，backend-code-generation明确traditional unsupported | 仅把已命名Type/Domain代入精确目录，不改变架构 | 路径已有人工文件则暂停而非覆盖 |
| PLAN-CLAR-003 | 局部OAuthKeyCipherComponent使用JDK AES-GCM而不是新crypto依赖 | common-crypto仅Digest/Hmac/Codec，没有AES/GCM；Spec §8.4明确该类型 | 实现选定JDK原语，不增第三方能力 | 若源组件新增AES接口须复核避免重复 |


### 6.5 Corrective gate C13 — 生产tenant SERVICE registration选择

- Origin: Step13 的consumer补齐；EVD-170/DEC-169/TEST-164/REQ-046。2026-10-09用户授权按推荐方案继续完成并探索阻塞解法。
- Baseline: Step17 HEAD `1dfd11960fa5c868766c1d50becea684a8a3ef27`；Step18未提交的所有已授权变化保留，暂停Step18源码推进，仅C13当前三路径接受修改和staging。
- Purpose/outcome: 不允许用一个TENANT issuer registration请求其他tenant的SERVICE token；两个租户必须显式选各自配置，当前Spring facade仍执行issuer/client/credentialVersion/audience/tenant/scope校验。
- Design: 复用现有mutable配置和生产Function Adapter，不建立新注册表服务/Strategy层；direct map选择是已知配置variation，不推导客户端或issuer。
- Test-first: 首先只改File1，BeanWrapper缺少新property导致真实assertion RED；随后File2/3 GREEN。不得以编译、网络或fixture失败作为RED。
- Compatibility: empty map保留单registration调用合同；nonempty map缺tenant立即拒绝；不改变HTTP/RPC/model public interfaces。
- Manual Checks: MC-ARCH-001,MC-REUSE-001,MC-DEP-001,MC-NAME-001,MC-VALID-001,MC-MODEL-001,MC-CONVERT-001,MC-LOG-001,MC-BEAN-001,MC-UTIL-001,MC-JSON-001,MC-TIME-001,MC-CONFIG-001,MC-PATTERN-001,MC-SCOPE-001,MC-TEST-001,MC-BLOCKER-001；十原Literal Rules分别检查。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@Component("oauthManagedDdlComponent") @Slf4j @RequiredArgsConstructor
class OAuthManagedDdlComponent {
  final @Qualifier("egonColaPostgreDdlRunner") EgonColaPostgreDdlRunner runner;
  final @Qualifier("egonColaShardingTopologyValidator") validator;
  initialize(physical,yaml) {
    topology=validator.validate(properties,yaml);
    manifest=loadOne("db/egon-mp/repository-manifest.json",family="tianquan-oauth");
    scoped=new SchemaScopedDataSource(physicalPrimary,"tianquan_oauth");
    target=(oauth_primary,tianquan_oauth,MASTER_DATA,scoped,manifest,topology.fingerprint);
    // private nested adapter wraps same pool: borrow connection, remember schema, setSchema(target).
    // close restores original schema then closes; denied unwrap must not leak raw pooled connection.
    // runner validates current_schema before its SET LOCAL search_path; passing raw public connection fails.
    // Restore failure closes connection and propagates; no second pool and no global schema mutation.
    runner.run(List.of(target)); // 不修改组件manifest，不自动adopt旧非空schema。
  }
}
```

```java
@Test void saves_identity_with_expected_version_in_fixed_directory_partition() {
  // 固定P，业务tenant A/B，global subject="user-x"；expectedVersion=7/newVersion=8。
  call IdentityPersistenceAdapter.save(changedUser, 7);
  assert SQL has tenant_id=P and version=7 and exactly one affected row;
  assert core result.id()=="user-x" and result.version()==8;
  assert tenant context restored after success and exception;
}
@Test void preserves_password_and_tenant_contracts() {
  assert ACTIVE/LOCKED/DISABLED, failedLoginCount, lockedUntil, mustChangePassword unchanged;
  assert hash roundtrip equals original Argon2 string; PO JSON/toString and core PasswordCredential.toString omit hash and subject;
  assert CLOSED cannot re-open and CLOSED membership cannot activate;
  assert update/delete partial PO uses matching group, not unconditional Persisted;
}
@Test void trustedDirectoryScopeRestoresMdcAfterSuccessAndFailure() {
  assert the fixed positive P is bound only inside the internal scope;
  assert previous tenant/user MDC values restore after nested, success and exception paths; preserve an authenticated user actor and use fixed service actor only when userId is absent;
}
@Test void platformPartitionIsRequiredAndSharedByBothProfiles() {
  assert base/local have the same environment placeholder with no default;
  assert absent/non-positive P fails closed and no request/JWT value selects P;
}
@Test void allFourDirectoryMappersUseTrustedPartitionAndActiveRows() {
  assert each mapper has explicit tenant_id=P and deleted_at IS NULL predicates;
  assert version guarded updates, external key mapping, and no JPA EntityManager in IdentityPersistenceAdapter;
}
@Test void tenantSettingsUseJsonbObjectBinding() {
  verify IdentityTenantSettingsJsonbTypeHandler sets JSON text with JDBC Types.OTHER;
  assert parsed settings root is object, valid object round-trips, invalid/scalar values fail;
}
@Test void mpNamedClockAliasUsesTheIdpClockInstance() {
  assert OAuthPersistenceConfiguration exposes egonColaMybatisPlusClock from @Qualifier("idpClock");
  assert the bean method returns that same Clock instance;
}
```

#### File 10 — `CREATE egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianquan/shoubing/admin/identity/repo/IdentityDirectoryContext.java`

- Purpose: 为全局目录访问建立内部、嵌套安全的固定P租户MDC作用域。
- Symbols: `withPlatformDirectoryPartition`, `directoryPartitionId`。
- Repository evidence: EgonColaTenantIdProvider只从配置MDC key读取Long；现有Shoubing源码无可信P来源或恢复helper。
- Dependencies and consumers: 应用required配置P、既有tenant/user MDC property keys；四个目录Repository/Adapter只在本地调用该scope。
- Why now: MP的TenantLine/写守卫从tenant MDC读取分区，MetaObjectHandler要求user MDC audit actor；直接调用会缺失或错误继承请求上下文。
- Contract/signature changes: 加入可信P scope；不暴露HTTP/RPC setter，不接受调用方自带P；PLATFORM realm后续使用同一配置。
- Input/output and state mapping: required property `egon.tianquan-shoubing.identity-directory.platform-storage-partition-id`；按MP tenant MDC key绑定Long P，按audit user MDC key保留可信actor或使用固定service actor fallback。
- Error and edge behavior: P缺失/非正数或MDC keys相同则启动失败；Supplier异常透传，finally分别恢复/移除tenant与user MDC，不抹除其他key。
- Standards impact: MC-VALID-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-TEST-001。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 9, Rule 10；无入站身份推导、使用现有Qualifier配置并保持try/finally作用域。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
INPUT -> required positive Long P plus the configured EgonColaMybatisPlusProperties.tenantId.mdcKey;
FLOW -> capture tenant/user MDC; bind fixed P; preserve a trusted current userId or set `service:tianquan-shoubing` only when absent; execute the synchronous directory call; in finally restore each prior value or remove its key;
ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> reject missing/non-positive P or identical MDC keys at bean construction; propagate data failure after restoring prior context;
RESULT -> TenantLine/ModelValidation see P and MetaObjectHandler sees a trusted actor only inside scope; outer request context is restored.
```

- Verification contribution: `IdentityMpPersistenceContractTest` proves nested scope, success/exception restoration and required P validation; no database required.
- After this file: trusted P context is reusable by all four directory persistence paths; no caller selects the partition.

```java
class IdentityUserRepository extends EgonColaRepository<IdentityUserDAO,IdentityUserPO> {

        else require value.version==expected+1;
        invoke guarded DAO and require affected==1;
  // tenant旧接口的findByCode/ForUpdate/list语义逐项保留；不再extends JpaRepository。
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
class IdentityTenantSettingsJsonbTypeHandler extends BaseTypeHandler<JsonNode> {
  setNonNullParameter(ps, index, node, jdbcType) -> ps.setObject(index, node.toString(), Types.OTHER);
  getNullableResult(...) -> parse with Jackson; require JSON object and <= 65536 UTF-8 bytes;
  ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> throw a safe SQL exception; never coerce an invalid value into a string scalar;
}
```

```java
@Repository("identityTenantRepository") @Slf4j @RequiredArgsConstructor @Validated

        else require value.version==expected+1;
        invoke guarded DAO and require affected==1;
  // tenant旧接口的findByCode/ForUpdate/list语义逐项保留；不再extends JpaRepository。
}
```

```java
@Repository("identityPersistenceAdapter") @Slf4j @RequiredArgsConstructor @Validated
class IdentityPersistenceAdapter implements IdentityUserStore, PasswordCredentialStore {
  final @Qualifier("identityUserRepository") IdentityUserRepository users;
  final @Qualifier("identityCredentialRepository") IdentityCredentialRepository credentials;
  findByNormalizedUsername(name): preserve trim/required; return users.findByNormalizedUsername(name);
  findById(subject): return users.findByIdentitySub(subject);
  findActive(subject): credentials.find(subject,PASSWORD).filter(status==ACTIVE);
  save(user,expectedVersion): return users.save(user,expectedVersion);
  save(credential,expectedVersion): return credentials.save(credential,expectedVersion);
  // 不开启不同TM/REQUIRES_NEW；原OptimisticLockingFailureException语义保留。
}
```

- Purpose: 为oauth_client三个JSONB文本数组提供强类型读写处理器。

```java
ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> malformed JSON, scalar/object root, non-text array item or invalid string raises SQLException;
```

#### File 3 — `CREATE egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianquan/shoubing/admin/token/config/OAuthKeyEncryptionProperties.java`

- Purpose: 建立keyId与外部mounted file Path的typed/validated配置对象。
- Symbols: `OAuthKeyEncryptionProperties`。
- Repository evidence: EVD-122；主Spec§10.1/§11.2.4–5 require AES-GCM ciphertext; current Shoubing source has no earlier AES-GCM payload bean.
- Dependencies and consumers: existing JDK JCA/ObjectMapper and validated TrustedRealmBO; used by Step 6 authorization/token converters and Step 7 key wrapper.
- Why now: encrypted fields are persisted in Step 6 and must not wait for a later Step’s crypto/config implementation.
- Contract/signature changes: ENC:v1, AES-256-GCM, keyId + random 96-bit nonce + 128-bit tag; AAD binds canonical issuer/realm/purpose/record; mounted 32-byte 0600 KEK required.
- Input/output and state mapping: JSON/opaque token value → UTF-8 plaintext within memory → authenticated envelope; plaintext never enters PO.
- Error and edge behavior: missing/unreadable/invalid key file, keyId mismatch, wrong realm/context, tag failure, malformed envelope/version all fail closed; no plaintext fallback.
- Standards impact: MC-DEP-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 11；只使用JDK JCA；profile keys parity且没有仓库secret。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```text
INPUT -> required nonsecret keyId and external mounted 32-byte KEK file;
FLOW -> bind key-id and key-file; reject blank keyId, missing/unreadable/non-32-byte KEK, and non-owner-only file permissions;
ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> absent or unsafe key, unknown keyId/version, wrong issuer/realm/purpose/record AAD or invalid GCM tag raises a stable fail-closed error;
RESULT -> payload ciphertext is authenticated and context-bound before persistence.
```

- Verification contribution: OAuthAuthorizationPersistenceContractTest exercises it with a temporary synthetic 32-byte key; no real KEK/service/database.
- After this file: trusted payload encryption and its configuration contract are available before entity converters/repositories use them.

### Step 9 — 实现授权码、PKCE和登录交互

- Requirements: REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-014, REQ-016
- Dependencies: Step 8
- Baseline state: 当前HEAD的对应源码/测试如每File的Repository evidence，先前Step已完成并有其focused GREEN；本Step尚不存在codeS256RedirectNonceReplay所列新行为。
- Observable outcome: 标准Code/PKCE/consent/login和机器Client Credentials签发保持scope/audience界限；PLATFORM USER 授权要求配置管理tenant的ACTIVE membership。
- End state: standard Code/PKCE/consent/login and machine Client Credentials remain bounded by scope/audience; PLATFORM USER authorization checks the configured management-tenant membership; successful issuance audit is durable in the local transaction and has a retryable Outbox delivery; later consumers remain uncutover.
- Test-first gate: Required — converter/S256 and explicit authorization-ID contracts were run RED first; GREEN verifies snapshot EVAL, platform membership, login/session/CSRF, Outbox stream whitelisting, and profile parity.
- Manual Checks: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-BLOCKER-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-CONVERT-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001
- Literal Rules: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 9, Rule 10, Rule 11
- Plan clarification: Step 9 keeps the existing root `/oauth2/*` controller dependencies active until Step 18 retires those endpoints. Remove only the exported single-issuer `idpJwtDecoder`; preserve the legacy `Rs256TokenService`/TokenFacade/refresh beans for those root handlers. The SAS chain uses its own tenant-aware `JwtDecoder` over the Step 8 JWKSource and verifies `iss` against `TenantIssuerService.resolveCurrentIssuer()`. The SAS built-in Basic provider authenticates against the tenant-scoped `RegisteredClientRepository`; the legacy JPA Basic authenticator remains confined to the root legacy token controller. `ClientCredentialsAccessPolicy` is the shared business rule; the root handler retains its separate URL until Step 18. Spring Authorization Server 1.5.8 `OAuth2Authorization.Builder.build()` assigns a UUID to a new authorization and its authorization-code provider stores the `OAuth2AuthorizationRequest` in `OAuth2Authorization.attributes`; File 14 treats that framework UUID as an absent storage ID and maps the trusted request attributes before persistence. For a new authorization-code transaction, File 14 allocates a positive Snowflake storage ID before inserting the row; the later code-exchange customizer uses the ID loaded from that row. For client_credentials, the JWT customizer allocates a positive numeric authorization ID before signing and persists that exact claim with version 0; no persistence path may replace a signed ID. File 6 introduces the security snapshot read needed by both signed claims and persisted authorizations: compare authoritative DB rows for REALM `self`, CLIENT decimal client PK, and USER subject against one same-slot Redis read-only EVAL of ready epoch and current generation/revision; fail closed if the DB/Redis view is missing or stale. Step 11 extends this component with the write-side projection. Client-credentials commands carry no fabricated token digest; only code/refresh consumption carries the actual presented token digest. Authorization, token, audit-row and Outbox enqueue share the local MP/DataSource transaction; delivery publishes only a typed safe audit envelope to the existing Redis Streams MQ; do not add a second transaction manager or copy Outbox component DDL.

#### File 6 — `CREATE egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianquan/shoubing/admin/token/service/impl/OAuthSecurityProjectionComponent.java`

- Purpose: read and validate the current authorization security-generation snapshot before a code or JWT can be committed.
- Symbols: `snapshotForAuthorization`, `requireCurrentSnapshot`.
- Repository evidence: existing `OAuthSecurityStateRepository.findByTargetForUpdate` is the DB authority; accepted Spec §15.1 defines ready/generation Redis keys, issuer hash slotting, and fail-closed behavior.
- Dependencies and consumers: uses only the existing MP state repository, Redisson primary client, canonical issuer digest, and the required operator epoch; Step 9 token issue and authorization persistence use the same component; Step 11 adds its write-side projection.
- Why now: SAS token customizers need the current REALM/CLIENT/USER generation tuple and authorization persistence must record the same snapshot.
- Contract/signature changes: require REALM target `self`, CLIENT decimal PK, and SUBJECT identitySub for USER; obtain DB rows under realm→client→subject lock order; one `RScript.Mode.READ_ONLY` EVAL returns ready epoch/status/revision and matching generations from same-slot keys; SERVICE omits subject. `requireCurrentSnapshot` compares the generation tuple while accepting a newer global revision when those generations are unchanged.
- Input/output and state mapping: canonical issuer hash is SHA-256 hex; subject key is SHA-256 of identitySub; ready epoch must match the required configured epoch; DB and Redis generation/enabled/revision must agree.
- Error and edge behavior: absent/disabled target, missing/stale projection, non-READY status, or epoch mismatch fails closed; DB/Redis dependency errors become temporarily_unavailable; never read from a replica or negative-cache.
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-BLOCKER-001.
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 9, Rule 11.
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
INPUT -> TrustedRealmBO, positive clientPk, USER/SERVICE principalType, and USER identitySub only.
FLOW -> lock REALM self then CLIENT then optional USER SUBJECT in the current DataSource transaction; issue one same-slot read-only EVAL; compare against the required ready epoch and fail closed on mismatch.
FAIL -> missing DB state, absent Redis hash, stale revision/generation, disabled state, or unavailable primary never emits a usable snapshot.
```

- Verification contribution: `OAuthOidcProtocolContractTest` asserts one READ_ONLY EVAL, same-slot hashed subject keys, exact DB/Redis tuple mapping, and missing ready rejection.
- After this file: downstream code can attach a current, typed security snapshot without adding Redis calls inside the user identity domain.

### Step 10 — 改造客户端、资源与密钥管理

- Requirements: REQ-002, REQ-005, REQ-011, REQ-013, REQ-017, REQ-026, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033
- Dependencies: Step 9
- Baseline state: 当前HEAD的对应源码/测试如每File的Repository evidence，先前Step已完成并有其focused GREEN；本Step尚不存在realmIsolatedBcryptRotation所列新行为。
- Observable outcome: 现有管理URL按Realm管理Client/Grant/Key；管理Controller先校验授权和realm意图，再把registry解析的TrustedRealmBO传给MP服务；Client secret一次明文返回，其余时间仅bcrypt；redirect在所有环境要求精确HTTPS，只有local profile下 opt-in 开发bootstrap可登记精确`127.0.0.1` HTTP回调；Resource与service Grant的Redis投影由component Outbox提交后重载当前MP事实。
- End state: 原管理URL/权限码保持；四个管理路径具备同realm MP隔离；全局Resource主目录固定PLATFORM realm，Grant归属真实client realm；production/nonlocal HTTP redirect拒绝，唯一loopback回调为local profile exact whitelist；不在业务事务内写Redis；Resource/CC Grant投影消息与MP事实原子提交并由幂等Outbox handler重载权威状态；key由每issuer encrypted keyring承载；未做多实例传播验收不宣称生产ready。
- Test-first gate: Required — controller realm传递、跨realm拒绝、realm resolver和per-realm key contract在实现前先RED；GREEN不连接数据库/Redis服务。
- Manual Checks: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-BLOCKER-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-CONVERT-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-UTIL-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001
- Literal Rules: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 9, Rule 10, Rule 11
- Plan clarification: Admin controllers are outside the AuthorizationServerContext; they must not call `resolveCurrentIssuer()` or infer realm from MDC. The new stateless `OAuthManagementRealmResolver` defaults an omitted realm to the authenticated principal's exact tenant, accepts `platform` only for the configured platform-management tenant with fresh STRONG authentication, resolves the registered issuer and passes the resulting `TrustedRealmBO` through service interfaces. Resource Server metadata is global and therefore uses only the validated PLATFORM realm; grants remain scoped to the chosen Client realm. Resource/CC Grant service writes enqueue a separate versioned projection event with the MP fact; the Outbox delivery handler validates its envelope, resolves the trusted realm, reloads current MP rows and alone invokes `ResourceServerProjectionService`. It never projects the event's stale snapshot. The original Tianshu disabled-admission event and handler remain separate. Client redirect validation enforces canonical HTTPS generally and accepts only an exact `http://127.0.0.1` callback with a valid port and callback path when the `local` Spring profile is active; it rejects local profile omissions from the whitelist and all other HTTP schemes/hosts. New signing keys use the existing realm-bound AES-GCM cipher and MP key/realm repositories; the legacy one-kid PEM runtime remains for root legacy token handlers and is not the SAS per-realm keyring. Runtime multi-instance/JWKS propagation remains a blocking Manual Check per main Spec TEST-008 and is not inferred from unit tests.

- Contract/signature changes: Mock resolver在测试中返回受信 PLATFORM realm，断言控制器传相同realm、资源标识与版本命令；权限码仍为 `tianquan-shoubing:resource-server:status`。

#### File 66 — `CREATE egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/platform/tianquan/shoubing/admin/resource/support/outbox/ResourceServerProjectionDeliveryHandler.java`

- Purpose: 将Resource/CLIENT_CREDENTIALS Grant runtime Redis投影迁移到独立component Outbox消费边界。
- Symbols: `ResourceServerProjectionDeliveryHandler`、`resource.server.project.v1`、`service.grant.project.v1`。
- Repository evidence: `TransactionalOutboxResourceServerEventAdapter`只发Tianshu disabled-admission命令；ResourceServerServiceImpl现有直接projection在MP事务内；`DeliveryHandlerRegistry`按channel分派并在Outbox持久状态支持失败重试。
- Dependencies and consumers: `OAuthResourceRepository`、`OAuthClientRepository`、`OAuthGrantRepository`、`OAuthManagementRealmResolver`、`ResourceServerProjectionService`、ObjectMapper；由ResourceServerConfig按named Bean装配。
- Why now: MP事实和Projection事件同事务后，需要一个只在Outbox提交后执行的权威重载消费者。
- Contract/signature changes: 独立 `identity-resource-projection` channel；固定两个destination；只接受schemaVersion=1；按可信PLATFORM或登记tenant realm重新读取MP当前Resource/Client/Grant，再调既有projection service；不信任事件snapshot或任意tenant。
- Input/output and state mapping: Resource event以resourceServerId/version定位；Grant事件以realmKey/clientId/resourceServerId/type/version定位；低版本事件读取并投影最新行，高版本早到消息retry。
- Error and edge behavior: 损坏envelope/未知destination/不可解析realm为permanent failure；Mapper/Redis暂时不可用为retryable failure；重复投递幂等，禁止旧版本覆盖新版本；Tianshu disabled handler保持独立。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-DEP-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 6, Rule 9, Rule 11。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
INPUT -> DeliveryContext from the component Outbox with exact channel, destination, schemaVersion and resource/grant key/version.
FLOW -> resolve trusted partition from the server registry; load current MP Resource/Client/Grant; project only authoritative current status/scopes.
FAIL -> malformed/unknown contracts fail permanently; dependency failures retry; never write Redis from event snapshots or inside the source MP transaction.
```

- Verification contribution: Step 10 focused `ResourceServerProjectionDeliveryHandlerTest` covers both destinations, realm isolation, replay/older versions, malformed events and retry classification.
- After this file: Redis projection delivery is owned by a named Outbox consumer, while the existing DDC disable consumer is unchanged.

### Step 11 — 闭合撤销、审计、密钥轮换

- Requirements: REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-014, REQ-015, REQ-016, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-034, REQ-035
- Dependencies: Step 10
- Baseline state: Step 10已提交；SAS默认撤销provider只更新token invalidation metadata，未写shared deny/Outbox；auth profiles缺accepted revocation/audit/rotation键；当前组件Outbox/MP能力已就绪。
- Observable outcome: SAS token revoke、Client security-material changes和身份subject变化写入同事务的安全事实、audit、Outbox；缺失REALM/CLIENT state仅在新系统无authorization/token/revocation历史时由fenced recovery初始化；首个已认证USER authorization可在无历史authorization时创建SUBJECT generation0；提交后Redis同revision可见之前不得成功；依赖失败503/pending且可由Outbox恢复；审计消费、过期清理和key rotation具备合同测试。
- End state: 成功撤销后新鉴权拒绝；Redis故障503但安全事实保留；审计可恢复；90天密钥任务遵循预发布与单active key；自动激活要求所有注册active issuer的共享安全projection处于当前READY epoch/revision；每个运行实例的JWKS缓存传播仍由TEST-008用户运行验收，不能由本Step单测证明；配置绑定和profile parity完整；Step 12 reader尚未切流，不声明生产ready。
- Test-first gate: Required — 初始RED覆盖SAS revoke/provider、security projection、identity same-transaction、audit delivery、retention与key rotation；RED由缺失行为而非容器/fixture启动失败导致；真实Redis/PG仍是用户运行门禁。
- Manual Checks: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-DEP-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-CONVERT-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-UTIL-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-TIME-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-BLOCKER-001
- Literal Rules: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 9, Rule 10, Rule 11
- Plan clarification from EVD-130/133/DEC-126/129: wrap the pinned SAS token-revocation provider in the same DataSourceTransactionManager boundary as its authorization save; persist deny/audit/Outbox facts before commit, then apply the same-revision projection after commit. Projection failure returns temporarily_unavailable while preserving the durable fact. Identity subject changes use the same generation/Outbox path and preserve legacy RT cleanup during transition. Extend the current OAuth audit Outbox route for a typed IDENTITY destination. Register starter audit properties/component and scheduling; auth base/local profiles receive accepted revocation/audit/key-rotation keys using mounted file references only.
- Retention correction from EVD-131/132/DEC-127/128: expose only the existing tenant/id/version guarded Audit and Revocation soft-delete operations. Filter revocation retention candidates to APPLIED and require the component Outbox active backlog count to be zero before deleting any revocation. Committed guarded soft-deletes are the durable progress marker: each retry queries from the first remaining active expired row, so no separate checkpoint table or DDL is needed. Delete audits after 180d; remove token rows only after their authorization family absolute expiry+24h, then guarded-delete the authorization; never delete live refresh families or permanent kid tombstones. Aged audit Stream messages are ACKed without re-persistence.

Snapshot remains READ_ONLY and rejects non-READY/stale values.

- Error and edge behavior: unsafe/cross-origin URI, remote plaintext HTTP/Redis, duplicate issuer value, malformed map label, unknown mode, excessive size, PLATFORM with business tenant, or missing multi-issuer epoch fails closed.

```java
OUTPUT -> registry/reader receive typed validated values; no value is sourced from an HTTP request.
FAIL -> invalid multi-issuer config prevents secure mode from starting; old single-issuer fallback remains explicitly isolated during migration.
```

```java
FLOW -> exact configured issuer -> immutable trust entry; stable issuer SHA-256 for the Redis hash slot.

FAIL -> unknown issuer returns empty and triggers no network call.
```

### Step 13 — 改造机器客户端缓存并装配WebClient

- Requirements: REQ-005, REQ-009, REQ-011, REQ-016
- Dependencies: Step 12
- Baseline state: 当前 `IdpServiceOAuth2Client` 已有本地缓存和per-key单飞，但缓存键缺issuer/client id/credentialVersion；授权store用固定principal分区，缓存无10000项上限/过期驱逐，也没有具名SERVICE WebClient filter。
- Observable outcome: 出站调用按issuer/client/凭据版/aud/tenant/scope隔离并临期重获，无client_credentials RT。
- End state: 出站调用按issuer/client/credentialVersion/aud/tenant/scope隔离本地与AuthorizedClientService缓存；≤10,000项、近过期活跃key单飞重获并清理底层缓存；named WebClient只向audience同origin发Bearer，401最多安全重试一次；无client_credentials refresh token。后续Step的Consumer尚未切流，不声明完整生产验收。
- Test-first gate: Required — 当前key与manager principal未包含issuer/client/credentialVersion，且无WebClient filter；先用目标测试确认串用和缺失保护，再实现。
- Design choice: reuse the existing `IdpServiceOAuth2Client`, `OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager` and per-key single-flight; use Spring `ExchangeFilterFunction` as the Adapter from a typed service-token request to one outbound Authorization header. Registration/trust lookup is the known variation point, so a new Strategy hierarchy would add no value.

### Step 14 — 建立SCG OAuth2登录和服务端会话

- Requirements: REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, REQ-040, REQ-041, REQ-042

- Observable outcome: 浏览器只有opaque Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax cookie；issuer/tenant/client/subject隔离的AuthorizedClient密文存储与OIDC session密文均server-side；TokenRelay refresh在同binding/client下跨实例串行，提交旋转token后才释放lock；API-015验证held JWT token/issuer/subject/audience并检查共享security snapshot，不触发refresh；logout只允许authenticated OAuth2 session+CSRF，原子持久化session全部密文intent后再清Session，所有远端2xx才204；依赖失败明确503/PENDING或503/UNKNOWN；`edge-bff` WebFlux OpenAPI group默认关闭，启用后由现有starter的scope chain保护。
- End state: SCG标准code+S256登录、会话固定防护、CSRF与受控Token Relay就绪；refresh token rotation跨实例单飞；current session view反映与held token相同的已验证JWT及共享Redis世代状态；logout retry可跨实例和进程恢复；Yuheng biz/mcp动态路由、SSE/MCP/LLM取消/背压及管理端口边界保持原状。真实Redis/AS/TLS与浏览器验收留给用户运行。
- Test-first gate: Required — POM wiring后先运行EdgeLoginContractTest；预期行为RED必须无编译/fixture/依赖错误，再按文件顺序实现。
- Design choice: Framework ServerOAuth2AuthorizedClientRepository adapter binds the complete trusted issuer tuple to Spring WebSession; an encrypted Redis Stream adapter owns durable logout retries. AES-GCM protects Spring Session and pending tokens; the existing OAuth2 client and Security APIs remain the extension points.
- Pattern rationale: 两个Adapter分别隔离Spring Security client repository、Spring Session serialization及Redisson Stream协议；算法与存储仅有一个受批准实现，增加Strategy/Factory层不会解决变化点。Lombok仅作为当前managed annotation API的provided依赖。

#### File 11 — `CREATE egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-yuheng/yuheng-edge-gateway/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/component/yuheng/edge/service/impl/EdgeSingleFlightAuthorizedClientManager.java`

- Purpose: Decorate the reactive OAuth2 client manager so a rotating refresh token is never concurrently consumed by two Edge instances.
- Symbols: `EdgeSingleFlightAuthorizedClientManager.authorize(OAuth2AuthorizeRequest)`.
- Repository evidence: Pinned Gateway TokenRelay calls `ReactiveOAuth2AuthorizedClientManager`; API-015–017 and main Spec §7.3.4 require cross-instance single-flight for BFF refresh rotation.
- Dependencies and consumers: File 10 supplies the stable session binding and File 6 supplies bounded wait/lease/token-timeout properties; EdgeSecurityConfiguration injects this decorator as the manager used by TokenRelay.
- Why now: The BFF AuthorizedClient must be stored in encrypted Redis before the lock releases, so the repository and lock manager are ordered before security-chain wiring.
- Contract/signature changes: Resolve the exact exchange from OAuth2AuthorizeRequest or ServerWebExchangeContextFilter; hash session binding, issuer, tenant, client, registration and subject into the Redisson lock key; acquire with bounded wait/lease, call the default manager so it reloads the current encrypted entry, and release only after the repository write completes.
- Input/output and state mapping: TokenRelay principal plus exact ClientRegistration; no client secret/token values in the lock key or logs.
- Error and edge behavior: Missing session/exchange, identity mismatch, lock timeout or provider timeout fails closed as temporarily unavailable; unlock runs after success, cancellation or error; old refresh token is never replayed after a failed refresh.
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-TEST-001; preserve the existing Gateway TokenRelay boundary.
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 2, Rule 4, Rule 7, Rule 9 and Rule 11; use one Decorator around the pinned manager, not a strategy registry.
- Design pattern consideration: The Decorator serializes one existing manager call by a known session/client identity across instances; a local synchronized map would not coordinate replicas and a larger strategy hierarchy adds no supported variation.
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
INPUT -> OAuth2AuthorizeRequest and the active Reactor ServerWebExchange context.
FLOW -> compute hashed session+issuer+tenant+client+registration+subject lock key; bounded RedissonReactiveClient lock; delegate.authorize reloads current RMapCache value and persists encrypted rotation before completion; unlock in async cleanup on every terminal signal.
ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> missing exchange, identity mismatch, failed lock acquisition or token endpoint timeout returns unavailable without sending the old refresh token.
RESULT -> TokenRelay receives only the latest persisted authorized client; no credential bytes enter the lock name.
```

- Verification contribution: `mvn -o -pl egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-yuheng/yuheng-edge-gateway -am -Dtest=EdgeLoginContractTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test`; TEST-145 uses two concurrent manager calls and mocked Redisson locks.
- After this file: TokenRelay has cross-instance refresh serialization before File 21 Gateway wiring.

#### File 11 — `MODIFY egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing/egon-cola-tianquan-shoubing-admin-web/src/api/types.ts`

- Purpose: 主Spec §12的授柄管理页面realm/密钥/资源身份联动。
- Symbols: `OAuthClientVO/CreateOAuthClientDTO/SigningKeyVO/GrantVO`。
- Repository evidence: 当前文件存在，源接口与现有UI状态已读；当前状态/调用见文件本身。
- Dependencies and consumers: Step 10管理API/Step 14 SCG session及现有Ant Design、React Query；输出供Admin操作员。
- Why now: 共享认证Client在本Step此前文件就绪，管理页面才可绑定已验证realm。
- Contract/signature changes: 旧类型保留字段名并新增issuer/purpose/allowedScopes; tenantId null只按协议；服务端issuer上下文通过会话选择；沿用既有管理URL及主Spec §9字段。
- Input/output and state mapping: issuer由session已选realm，clientId/resourceId来自当前页面；VO只显示非秘密状态/版本，切tenant使queryKey不同并失效旧缓存。
- Error and edge behavior: 未授权不读取其他tenant；空、加载、权限、依赖失败分支独立；保存/删后按当前realm刷新。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001；TypeScript字段与Java VO/JSON一致。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 11；仅消费Jackson已公开字段，保持前端原结构和各环境配置一致。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
INPUT -> 当前已验realm、已有UI路由、现有HttpClient和主Spec §9管理字段。
FLOW -> 旧类型保留字段名并新增issuer/purpose/allowedScopes; tenantId null只按协议；服务端issuer上下文通过会话选择。
OUTPUT -> OAuthClientVO/CreateOAuthClientDTO/SigningKeyVO/GrantVO使同一页只显示目标realm的数据/状态，写操作由服务端再次核验。
FAIL -> 401进入登录、403显示拒绝、404提示当前Client不存在、503保留可重试状态；不渲染令牌、私钥或跨realm缓存。
```

#### File 45 — `MODIFY egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-xingyuan-admin-portal/vite.config.ts`

- Purpose: 确保本地Vite/preview模式把OIDC入口、BFF session端点和OIDC callback交给同一Edge auth upstream。
- Symbols: `server.proxy`。
- Repository evidence: 当前Vite配置代理`/oauth2`，但`/bff/*`和`/login/oauth2/code/*`会落入前端SPA fallback。
- Dependencies and consumers: 复用已有Portal auth proxy环境变量；现有manifest/API代理维持原目标。
- Why now: 新OIDC导航需要Edge callback，BFF logout/session还需要相同的cookie origin。
- Contract/signature changes: 仅增加`/bff`和`/login/oauth2`路径规则，复用`/oauth2`的配置Edge upstream，并设置`changeOrigin: false`保留原始Host供`{baseUrl}`回调使用。
- Input/output and state mapping: `/oauth2/authorization/{registrationId}`、`/bff/*`与`/login/oauth2/code/*`进入Edge并保留前端Host，使OIDC回调返回原前端origin；业务API继续走原`/api`规则。
- Error and edge behavior: `VITE_YUHENG_ORIGIN`显式设置时直接请求该Edge origin；空值时同源Vite/preview路由必须完成OIDC回调和BFF请求。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001；只增加既有auth upstream的路径映射。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 7, Rule 11；同一路径集合在本地dev/preview中一致，模块边界不变。
- Design pattern consideration: N/A；Vite现有代理映射直接扩展，不需要新helper或proxy abstraction。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
INPUT -> existing OAuth2 auth proxy target and API proxy target
FLOW -> map /oauth2, /bff, and /login/oauth2 to the auth target with changeOrigin=false in every applicable dev/preview proxy table
OUTPUT -> OIDC start, BFF session/logout and callback reach Edge; existing /api target remains
FAIL -> callback Host leaving the frontend origin, callback resolving to SPA HTML, or BFF requests reaching Admin direct is a proxy review failure
```

- Verification contribution: Portal TypeScript package check and static assertion that all auth proxy paths target the shared auth upstream with changeOrigin=false; no Vite server or browser is started.
- After this file: The Portal development proxy follows the Edge OIDC/BFF route contract.

- Input/output and state mapping: `/oauth2/authorization/{registrationId}`、`/bff/*`与`/login/oauth2/code/*`进入Edge并保留前端Host，使OIDC回调返回原前端origin；业务API继续走原`/api`规则。
- Error and edge behavior: `VITE_YUHENG_ORIGIN`显式设置时直接请求该Edge origin；空值时同源Vite/preview路由必须完成OIDC回调和BFF请求。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-CONFIG-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001；只增加既有auth upstream的路径映射。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 7, Rule 11；同一路径集合在本地dev/preview中一致，模块边界不变。
- Design pattern consideration: N/A；Vite现有代理映射直接扩展，不需要新helper或proxy abstraction。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
INPUT -> existing OAuth2 auth proxy target and API proxy target
FLOW -> map /oauth2, /bff, and /login/oauth2 to the auth target with changeOrigin=false in every applicable dev/preview proxy table
OUTPUT -> OIDC start, BFF session/logout and callback reach Edge; existing /api target remains
FAIL -> callback Host leaving the frontend origin, callback resolving to SPA HTML, or BFF requests reaching Admin direct is a proxy review failure
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
INPUT -> no old RT/code/consent; old client external ID preserved。
FLOW -> @Service("oauthMigrationService") @Slf4j @RequiredArgsConstructor; read old snapshot via fixed DAO; bind all mapped source fields in the report digest using hashes for sensitive values; validate canonical tenant, owner map, USER PKCE and zero SERVICE refresh TTL; service clients keep Resource associations only in Grant rows; issue only approved scopes and fresh BCrypt credentials; 500 rows per transaction; checkpoint only after verified target commit
ON INVALID/CONCURRENT/DEPENDENCY FAILURE -> invalid/ambiguous ownership report, no auto repair。
RESULT -> only the named symbol/contract in this File block becomes available; preserve tenant, expectedVersion, scope, UTC time and secret masking stated above.
```

- Why now: 真实测试证实正式issuer/旧root链冲突，必须在旧协议GREEN和提交前关闭；用户已授权遇到阻塞按推荐方案继续。
- Contract/signature changes: 只正式 `/platform/...` / `/tenants/<canonical-id>/...` 进入SAS；root交给旧协议410；SAS使用现有BCryptPasswordEncoder(12)验证raw hash，禁止重复Authorization或Basic/body混用。
- Input/output and state mapping: endpoint matcher精确排除旧root；保持SAS默认client认证与授权provider，只配置已存在client-secret provider和前置不变式；无额外签发/secret转换。
- Error and edge behavior: 不合法认证输入返回安全OAuth错误且无token/secret；不对原hash加密二次，不吞异常；新issuer流程和PKCE保持。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001, MC-DEP-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-BEAN-001, MC-JSON-001, MC-PATTERN-001, MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001；复用Spring/SAS默认策略和现有crypto，不引入依赖/新Filter层。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 9, Rule 10, Rule 11；既有配置扩展点内完成认证边界，不新建策略注册表。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
RequestMatcher canonicalIssuer = request -> contextRelativePath(request).matches("/(platform|tenants/[1-9][0-9]{0,18})/.*");
http.securityMatcher(new AndRequestMatcher(canonicalIssuer, protocolAndLogin));
require configured token generator and OAuthTokenIssueService/transactionManager; // 缺失即构链失败，禁止默认无security claims签发。
remove ConditionalOnBean from mandatory tenantOAuthTokenGenerator;
clientAuthentication.authenticationConverters(converters -> converters.add(0, request -> {
    if (duplicateAuthorization(request) || bodySecret(request) || basicAndBodyClientId(request)) {
        throw new OAuth2AuthenticationException(new OAuth2Error("invalid_client", "Request rejected", null));
    }
    return null; // 默认SAS认证converter继续执行；无自制Basic解码。
}));
clientAuthentication.authenticationProviders(providers -> providers.forEach(provider -> {
    if (provider instanceof ClientSecretAuthenticationProvider secretProvider) {
        secretProvider.setPasswordEncoder(new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12));
    }
}));
```

## 9. Migration, Compatibility, Rollout, and Rollback

以当前修订Spec§16为主：PREPARED先建立15表单应用manifest与组件自有manifest→DIRECTORY-FROZEN全局停写身份目录、旧publisher及全部写者→DIRECTORY-VERIFIED显式导入四表/身份审计并逐字段对账、统一切MP目录权威→OUTBOX-VERIFIED区分组件legacy表迁移与旧自有identity事件分类→REALM-VERIFIED/CUTOVER按已授权tenant导入client/grant/新bcrypt secret并重新登录→RETIRED旧Java/JPA装配与旧URL退役，旧SQL/源表保留。

全局用户目录不能按realm维持两份可写权威。legacy未切issuer如继续服务必须先接同一MP目录，否则保持统一维护窗口；不允许“旧部署继续写public、新部署写新schema”。component migration-mode不是全fleet栅栏。应用只有V20261008_001__initialize_oauth_tenant_schema.sql与repository-manifest.json；旧V1–V6和组件jar SQL不改；迁移DTO/XML显式写version/create_time/update_time，不走save/fill。

组件旧public.egon_cola_outbox_message使用OutboxLegacyMigrationService verifyOnly→审核后apply；旧identity_outbox_event不适用组件迁移器，按修订§16处理投影重建、审计幂等确认和未知事件阻断。每批500、unknown commit先重读、checkpoint仅目标确认后推进。新目录或安全世代已有写入后只forward-fix或经审核逆向迁移，禁止回旧JPA源覆盖新secret/generation。Redis恢复沿原fence/readiness/epoch规则，不因此放宽即时撤销。

本轮不执行迁移、secret轮换、应用启动或浏览器验收；真实地址/secret只由安全配置注入，不写文档/日志/报告。每个逻辑Step最多一个commit，未通过门禁不得开始下一Step。

## 12. Review and Acceptance

### 12.1 Original requirement fidelity

原REQ-001–018与修订REQ-020–027逐项映射；REQ-019按本次请求只扩大文档产物范围。保留用户数据/Flyway、三层、禁generator与禁自动运行。API-045加入后端/前端/文档和测试，先前缺GET的计划缺口已闭合。

### 12.2 Spec consistency

Spec先定义四目录MP、审计兼容列、组件Outbox、全局目录切流与消费者边界；Plan只落实文件/顺序。共享OAuthSecurityVersionBO下沉core，不让Starter依赖admin；身份策略和HTTP DTO/VO保持。没有把主Spec未被点名的协议合同重写。

### 12.3 Repository executability

基线固定当前HEAD，保留原17步未变设计并新增目录步骤；新增调用者清单从Entity真实引用导出。单文件操作与提交路径从本章清单一致生成。执行前刷新diff与依赖缓存；命令不存在、环境未起或仅validator通过不能代替行为测试。

### 12.4 Test and release completeness

RED/GREEN、同TM配置拒错、历史字段/幂等/停写、API-045与Tianshu双层信任均有门禁。Step 18必须依赖Step 16和17完成；删除JPA类/依赖必须等全引用迁完并通过模块编译。真实PG/Redis/浏览器/流式运行证据由用户启动环境后补齐，不在本轮执行。
